visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Table Stops One Row Early
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The table of 5 should run from 5 x 1 up to 5 x 10, but the last row (5 x 10 = 50) is missing.

solution.explanation: i < 10 stops when i reaches 10, so the tenth row is never printed. To include the last value the loop condition has to be i <= 10.
